startHere.label: core rows
startHere.title: Read likely Volume XX document candidates
startHere.body: Begin with non-boundary, non-Egypt-overlap conversation records that already have declassified source notes and most often diary/backup confirmation.

startHere.label: blocker rows
startHere.title: Resolve source-copy and declassification blockers
startHere.body: Handle no-memorandum markers, partial releases, and restricted rows before making final selection or MDR/referral decisions.

startHere.label: overlap rows
startHere.title: Settle Egypt, Gulf, Arab-Israeli, and terrorism ownership
startHere.body: Tag each overlap row before selection so Africa-specific material remains in Volume XX and companion-volume material is handed off cleanly.

startHere.label: critical gaps
startHere.title: Fill the missing source base
startHere.body: Move from presidential conversations into State Department files, NSC policy packets, Libya/Pan Am records, and the 1992 Africa policy review trail.

startHere.label: diary matches
startHere.title: Use diary and backup material as control evidence
startHere.body: Use NAID 186322 date matches to verify time, location, attendee, and call-status evidence, while treating it as control material rather than minutes.
